name: Impose Order (Infernal Pactbreaker)

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Trigger An enemy adjacent to you damages you.

---
You impose the strict language of your folio on those around you. The triggering enemy takes ternary(gte(@actor.level,20,6,ternarygte(@actor.level,17,5,ternarygte(@actor.level,13,4,ternarygte(@actor.level,10,3,2)))))d6 mental damage with a basic Will save save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. This damage increases to 3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 13th level, 5d6 at 17th level, and 6d6 at 20th level.
